newsitem.title: CANADA: Cara to take stake in Spectra.
newsitem.headline: Cara to take stake in Spectra.

text.p: Restaurant chain and catering company operator Cara Operations Ltd said on Thursday it concluded a deal with the Spectra Group of Great Restaurants Inc under which Cara will take a 22 percent stake in Spectra.

The deal will also grant to Cara warrants which if exercised would result in Cara boosting its holding to 35 percent of the outstanding voting shares of Spectra and 36.7 percent of the non-voting shares.
Under the agreement, Cara will initially buy 506,970 voting shares and 1.94 million non-voting shares at C$2.25 per share for a total price of C$5.5 million.

In addition, Cara will get warrants to allow it to buy from treasury the same number of voting and non-voting shares exercisable at C$2.55 per share on or before the warrants expire on April 22, 1998.

If all the warrants are exercised in full, C$6.2 million more will be injected into Spectra's treasury and Cara will then hold 35.4 percent of the outstanding voting shares and 36.7 percent of the non-voting shares on a non-diluted basis.
Cara said it has entered into a standstill agreement capping its ownership at 37 percent for a period of five years.
Spectra operates 33 restaurants in the U.S. and Canada.

"The management teams of both Cara and Spectra believe there are tremendous opportunities for cross-learning between the two restaurant organizations, and cross-branding of their respective brands," said Cara President and Chief Operating Officer Gabe Tsampalieros in a statement.
